svg.text: J1-J2 square: the best energies at each size
10 Hamiltonians, one panel per set of couplings, at every size with a published result. Each size is placed against its exact
energy where it has one (sizes in grey), otherwise against the standing record (sizes in orange), whose holder then sits in the
band above the plot. One line per method family through its best energy at each size; a better energy is higher.
Below the energy it is measured against
Sizes are numbers of sites. A family's line joins its best energy at each size, whichever paper set it, so a line is a family's reach rather than
one calculation. Where the reference is the record, the heights say how far behind the others are and nothing about the record itself.
